title: § 28-211.1 False statements in certificates, forms, written statements, applications, reports, or certificates of correction.

blocks.html: It shall be unlawful for any person to knowingly or negligently make or allow to be made a material false statement in any certificate, professional certification, form, signed statement, application, report or certification of the correction of a violation that is either submitted directly to the department or that is generated with the intent that the department rely on its assertions.
